verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents an MD_INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY view that records every query run across the organization, which covers the query-audit half of the story. Nothing in the evidence describes column-level lineage. missing for 10: column-level lineage of data origins, explicit documentation that query history attributes queries to specific users, retention and export details for audit logs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I get audit logs of who ran what and column-level lineage of where data came from

citations.quote: The MD_INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY view records every query run across your organization.
